text: @jasonqq/dsh-btw-plugin 是 DeepSeek Harness 的旁支提问命令插件，提供 /btw 命令并通过子 agent 单独回答问题。它默认使用 fork 子上下文，让回答能参考主会话已完成的对话，同时把结果作为命令响应展示。用户可以切换 provider，并设置子 agent 的递归深度上限；插件也会处理空问题、provider 不可用、运行失败和空回答等情况。适合希望临时追问又不把回答加入主会话模型历史的 DSH 用户。配置 provider 与 maxDepth 即可调整运行方式。

@jasonqq/dsh-btw-plugin adds /btw to DeepSeek Harness for side questions. By default, a fork subagent receives completed conversation turns, and its answer returns as a command result. Configure the provider or optional recursion-depth cap. Empty input and failed or empty runs return errors.
想在不扩充主会话历史的情况下临时问个旁支问题
让 DSH 用当前对话背景回答一个临时问题
有没有办法把一个追问交给独立的子 agent
我希望旁边的问题有上下文，但回答别进入主模型历史
如何在会话输入框里发起一次单独的上下文提问
给我一个能依据当前对话回答小问题的命令
Ask a quick follow-up using the current conversation as context.
How can I delegate a side question without adding its answer to the main model history?
@jasonqq/dsh-btw-plugin 的功能「独立上下文提问」：用户在会话输入框运行 /btw 并附上问题；插件将问题交给子 agent，默认 fork provider 可带入主会话已完成的轮次。（触发方式：/btw 命令）。
@jasonqq/dsh-btw-plugin 的功能「旁支回答不进入主历史」：子 agent 的文本回答作为命令结果返回并显示；插件返回 success 结果，不把它转换为主模型消息。（触发方式：/btw 命令）。
@jasonqq/dsh-btw-plugin 的功能「provider 与深度配置」：可指定子 agent provider（默认 fork）及可选 maxDepth，并在启动时传递这些配置。触发方式：运行 /btw。
@jasonqq/dsh-btw-plugin 的功能「清晰处理失败与空答复」：命令遇到空输入、provider 缺失、启动或运行错误、非完成停止原因及空文本时，返回对应错误结果。（触发方式：/btw 命令）。
@jasonqq/dsh-btw-plugin 提供命令 /btw：Ask a side question in a sub-context; the answer stays out of the main context

@jasonqq/dsh-btw-plugin README · @jasonqq/dsh-btw-plugin：A Codex-style `/btw` command for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

`/btw <question>` answers a side question **in a sub-context seeded with the main
conversation**, and shows the answer in the chat **without ever adding it to the
main conversation's model history**. Ask "by the way…" questions freely — the
main context stays clean.

@jasonqq/dsh-btw-plugin README · How it works：- The command is registered through `@deepseek-ai/dsh-commands` (the same
  registry that powers `/compact`, `/goal`, `/plan`).
- The question is delegated through `ctx.subagents.start("fork", …)`. The
  `fork` provider spawns a child agent **seeded with the parent's completed
  turns**, so the side question is answered with full knowledge of the main
  conversation.
- The child's answer is returned as a plain command result. Command results are
  rendered by the UI adapter and **never enter the model history** — that is the
  "no pollution" guarantee.

@jasonqq/dsh-btw-plugin README · Usage：In any session composer:

```
/btw <question>
```

The answer appears as a command result card. It does not become a message the
main model sees, so you can reference it yourself without bloating the context.

@jasonqq/dsh-btw-plugin README · Install：The plugin ships as a Cordis plugin and plugs into any profile that mounts
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-commands` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent` (both are part of
the shipped `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` composition).

1. Make the package resolvable from the profile, e.g. link it into the shared
   profile store:

```bash
   mkdir -p ~/.dsh/profiles/node_modules/@jasonqq
   ln -s "$PWD" ~/.dsh/profiles/node_modules/@jasonqq/dsh-btw-plugin
   ```

@jasonqq/dsh-btw-plugin README · Install：2. Add it to the profile patch layer (`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`):

```yaml
   - insert:
       - id: btw
         name: @jasonqq/dsh-btw-plugin
         config:

The profile patch is read at boot. In the desktop app, restart the app
   after editing it (the CLI `dsh web` runner hot-reloads its patches).

@jasonqq/dsh-btw-plugin README · Compatibility：The command surface this plugin depends on — `commands.register()`,
`CommandInvocation`, `CommandResult`, `subagents.getProvider()` / `start()`,
`SubagentRun.result` / `dispose()`, `SubagentResult.output` / `stopReason` and
the five stop reasons — is unchanged across those lines. The one difference in
`0.2.0` is a tightening: `SubagentResult.output` is now `readonly
ContentBlock[]`, which this plugin's `filter`/`map` usage already satisfies.

@jasonqq/dsh-btw-plugin README · Configuration：| Key        | Default  | Meaning                                                                  |
| ---------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `provider` | `"fork"` | Subagent provider. `fork` seeds the child with the parent's completed turns (sees the main context); `spawn` starts a fully standalone child. |
| `maxDepth` | (unset)  | Optional recursion-depth cap for the child; defaults to the harness default when omitted. |

@jasonqq/dsh-btw-plugin README · Development：```bash
npm test
```

The tests exercise the handler with a stubbed `ctx.subagents` seam — no live
model or host is needed.
